breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the inconsistency by omitting the contradictory preamble about grid conventions. It instead extracted the correct, specific instruction from the 'Numerical method requirements' section of the prompt, stating: 'Create a uniform periodic grid with Nx=512 points on [0,1) using x_j = j*dx for j=0,...,Nx-1 with dx=1/Nx.' This aligns perfectly with the ground truth's resolution, which was to remove the contradictory text.
